top_signals.title: Iran Says Agreement on Hormuz Shipping Reached With Oman
top_signals.summary: Iran said it had reached an agreement with Oman on a proposed route for shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a potential step toward a reopening of the critical waterway for energy supplies. Bloomberg's Abeer Abu Omar has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
